changes.title: A notice beside your work
changes.description: Update available floats at the lower left when a newer version is ready. Choose Later to keep working, or Update now to refresh. The update controls have left the sidebar.

changes.title: See what changed after updating
changes.description: When you refresh or return on a new version, its release notes open automatically. Got it acknowledges them; refreshing before dismissal keeps them waiting.

changes.title: Catch up from where you left off
changes.description: Each open tab remembers its own version. Returning later includes every new batch since your last acknowledgement, while a first visit starts quietly.

changes.title: Keep updates within reach
changes.description: The same notice works across your workspace, Settings, brief, and update history pages, even with navigation collapsed. Summaries still include their own working HTML demos.

title: Pictures and demos with your updates

changes.title: A picture of what changed
changes.description: Update cards can include a real screenshot and a caption explaining what to look for.

changes.title: Try a little demonstration
changes.description: Interactive previews let you switch views and explore native controls directly in the update.

changes.title: Explore with your keyboard
changes.description: Interactive demonstrations accept keyboard focus. Use Tab and Enter to explore the example and open its full details.

preview.caption: A real capture of an HTML summary preview. Try the update notice demo in “A clearer view of what’s new” below.
preview.alt: An Albatross update preview with Summary and Full details controls, showing a short summary of five changes.

changes.title: Updates have a home
changes.description: Open What’s new in the sidebar to find a dated history of changes to Albatross.

changes.title: Less to read, more to discover
changes.description: Batches with more than three changes start with a short summary. Expand them for every detail; smaller batches stay visible.

changes.title: See the change
changes.description: Visual updates can include a small rendered preview, so you can see what changed alongside the explanation.

changes.title: Know when an update is ready
changes.description: Albatross checks for new versions while you work. Review the changes and choose when to reload.

changes.title: Pick up where you left off
changes.description: A quiet dot marks updates you haven’t opened yet. Visiting What’s new clears it in this browser.
